Frustrating Signup Experience. This is one of the most frustrating signup experiences I’ve had. Requiring both email and a verified mobile number just to order feels unnecessarily complicated. Even after signing up with my email, I’m still blocked because my number isn’t verified, so I can’t place my order. A simple email should be enough to create an account, as some services allow, so people can start shopping without extra hurdles. For example, some platforms prioritize a quick email-based signup to keep the process easy. The current friction can stop genuine customers from placing orders, which is frustrating and a missed opportunity. Please simplify the signup flow so customers can get started with just an email.

Because of this, Myntra is making me bear a loss of nearly ₹6,000 for products that were not what I ordered. As a customer, I expected Myntra to trace the issue, verify the deliveries, and provide a fair resolution instead of simply rejecting the returns. Myntra should improve its customer support and ensure sellers are held accountable when they ship incorrect products.

Anonymous. This is by far one of the worst shopping experiences I have ever had. The app is completely unprofessional, customer service is useless, and the overall quality is extremely poor. They misguided me about the delivery timeline, and due to my visa delay, I was unable to check the dress sizes on time — a situation I clearly explained multiple times.

Despite the large number of return items and the huge amount involved, the support team showed zero empathy, zero flexibility, and zero willingness to listen. They behave as if customers don’t matter once payment is done. Messages go unanswered, explanations are ignored, and they hide behind rigid policies instead of handling genuine situations responsibly.

This platform is NOT customer-friendly at all. It feels like they are trained to deflect responsibility rather than solve problems. I am now stuck with expensive items that I cannot use, entirely due to their misleading information and lack of support.

Even basic retail services in the UK are far more professional, ethical, and customer-oriented than this app. This experience has been nothing short of mental harassment and financial stress.

I strongly warn others: DO NOT BUY from this website/app. If something goes wrong, you will be left alone with no help, no response, and no accountability.

I will be formally filing complaints on the app, payment provider, and consumer protection platforms, as this level of service is unacceptable.
